title: Invariant sets of the double Hilbert transform
summary: We present an example that shows that the double Hilbert transform $\H$ can have the characteristic function of an open set of finite measure in $\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}$ as an approximate eigenvector for the eigenvalue $1$. The same holds for the dyadic model of $\H$, the double dyadic shift. We further construct non-diagonal sets whose indicators are fixed by $\H$ -- strips bent along the Boole curve $x=y-1/y$ and, more generally, along level curves of real Herglotz functions with purely singular measures -- and study the class of invariant sets which they generate.
